#: Submit's edge cases on the stand-in (run.py --cases submit-edges --expect). A texture without a handle is refused (102, InvalidTexture) and its eye isn't counted, as SteamVR answers, so the other eye's texture after it is taken. A cube map skybox needs the runtime's equirect layers, which the stand-in hasn't (1, RequestFailed). Windows refuses a Background app at Init (121); on Linux it may Init, and its Submit answers 103 (IsNotSceneApplication).
